_help: Spellcraft: build your own skills from cards, in the spirit of Two Worlds II (read by scripts/Spellcraft.cs, menu B). A spell needs one CARRIER (how it is delivered) and one EFFECT (what it does); MODIFIER cards change it. Extra copies of the same card stack (boosters). A spell can have a second section that goes off where the first one ends (a missile that bursts into an area = a fireball). Carriers come in three families: spell (mana, spell power), martial (stamina, weapon damage) and archery (stamina, weapon damage, needs a bow), so every class can craft. A carrier copies its numbers from an existing skill in data/skills.json ('from'), with 'set' overriding some of them; the effect then replaces its damage type, statuses and (for enchant and ward carriers) its buffs. Modifier 'mods' use the same keys as supports in data/skills.json. Cards are found: kill drops, chests, bosses; every hero starts with a kit for their class.

slots._help: cards per spell (both sections together): base + 1 per perLevels levels + the class bonus for the spell's family, at most max

mastery._help: copies of one card a spell may hold: base + 1 per perLevels levels (Two Worlds II magic mastery)

stack._help: each extra copy of the spell's effect card: +effectP % damage and healing, +statusDurP % status duration, buffs +effectP %. Each extra copy of its carrier card: radius/speed/duration/range/count grow by these %. Every card past the first two raises the cost by costP %.

second._help: the second section goes off where the first one ends: costs add up (costP % of its own cost), its cooldown adds cdP %. Only these carriers can be a second section.

classSlots._help: extra cards per spell by class and family

classFamilies._help: which starter kits a class gets

drops._help: chance a kill or chest gives a card (elite = an upgraded monster). Bosses give bossCards. A card is picked by type weight, then by its own 'w', among cards with req <= hero level + reqAhead.

missile.d: A bolt that flies to your aim and explodes.
missile.stackHint: Each extra copy: faster and a wider blast.

area.stackHint: Each extra copy: a wider burst.

strike.d: A pillar falls on your target from the sky.
strike.stackHint: Each extra copy: a wider impact.

trap.d: A rune on the ground that erupts when a foe steps on it.
trap.stackHint: Each extra copy: lasts longer, a wider blast.

altar.d: Raises an altar that strikes the nearest foe again and again.
altar.stackHint: Each extra copy: stands longer and reaches farther.

wall.d: A line of magic across your aim that harms anything crossing it.
wall.stackHint: Each extra copy: lasts longer, thicker.

vortex.d: A well that drags foes in, then implodes.
vortex.stackHint: Each extra copy: a wider well.

beam.d: A ray you hold on the crosshair; it harms all along its length.
beam.stackHint: Each extra copy: longer and held longer.

orbit.d: Motes circle you and harm whatever they touch.
orbit.stackHint: Each extra copy: a wider ring that lasts longer.

enchant.d: Blesses you and nearby allies with the effect's power.
enchant.stackHint: Each extra copy: lasts longer, reaches farther.

ward.d: A shield that soaks damage, shaped by the effect.

slash.d: A wide swing of your weapon.

whirl.d: You spin, striking all around each turn.
whirl.stackHint: Each extra copy: a wider spin.

leap.d: Leap to your target and slam down.
leap.stackHint: Each extra copy: leap farther, a wider slam.

lunge.d: Dash forward, striking all in your path.

quake.d: Stamp the ground: it heaves around you in waves.

blades.stackHint: Each extra copy: a wider ring that lasts longer.

glaive.d: A thrown blade that arcs out and back.

rain.stackHint: Each extra copy: a wider rain that lasts longer.

rebound.d: An arrow that bounces between foes.
rebound.stackHint: Each extra copy: a faster shot.

snare.d: A hidden trap; the first foe to step on it is held fast.
snare.stackHint: Each extra copy: lasts longer, a wider snare.

frost.d: Frost damage; chills foes. Three chills freeze.

storm.d: Lightning damage; may shock foes so they take more damage.

holy.d: Holy damage; judged foes take more damage.

shadow.d: Shadow damage; weakened foes deal less damage.

stone.d: Heavy physical blows that sunder armor and may root foes.

life.d: Holy damage that heals you for a quarter of it. On an enchant or ward it heals over time.

protection.d: Each cast mends you for 3% of your health.

homing.d: Missiles seek foes; other carriers find weak spots instead.

spray.d: Two more missiles (or bursts, strikes, waves), each 20% weaker.

ricochet.d: Hits leap on to two more foes.

pierce.d: Missiles pass through two foes; other hits sunder armor.

force.d: Hits knock foes back and stun them briefly.

echo.d: The spell goes off once more, 30% weaker.

wide.d: 40% larger area; on carriers without one, a reach or blast of their own.

reflex.d: While on your hotbar, the spell casts itself when you are hit (every 3 s at most).
